title: Life in Color
description: This 1962 photo shows for-sale cars parked under colorful flags at a dealership in Los Angeles, California. It was taken by Jacques Henri Lartigue, best known for documenting car racing, aviation, and French high society in black-and-white photos. He also took pictures of his trips to the United States toward the end of his life.
translated_description: 这张1962年的照片拍摄于加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的一家汽车经销商处，待售车辆停放在五彩缤纷的旗帜下。照片由雅克·亨利·拉蒂格拍摄，他以用黑白照片记录赛车、航空和法国上流社会而闻名。他在晚年旅美期间也拍摄了许多照片。
